$Comment: What You Already Paid: a head start with the Mastery Trainer for every player who ever paid the
Mastery Tithe (Pack_Mastery_Tithe.json), which the trainer's lessons have replaced.
Requires opens it to anyone with the mastery feature on who has collected the tithe at least once:
ziggfreedcommon:quest_completions counts collections from the player's own record, so it answers
even though nobody is handed the tithe itself. AutoAccept puts it in the log the moment that
holds, at login included, and AutoTrack pins it, so a past payer finds it waiting without being told.
Listing.RequirePrerequisites keeps it out of everyone else's Objective Book; a past payer whose log
was full when it tried to arm still finds it there to take by hand.
Its one step is a talk at the trainer, credited by the MarkTalked beat on the tithe_credit line of
the trainer's conversation (Dialogues/MMOSkillTree/Mmo_Mastery_Trainer.json): pressing F alone
credits nothing, so re-point the step and that beat has to move with it. TurnInAt names the
trainer, so the reward waits in the Claim bucket until the player collects it from the trainer's
own quest list, which that line opens.
It pays 3000 standing with the trainer (the Reputation reward): Honored, the rank called Trusted
Student, so the achievements for Student and Trusted Student wait in the book at once. Edit the
Amount to start past payers somewhere else on the ladder.
